request.title: The crown and the airship
request.prompt: Painterly dark-fantasy illustration in the style of a cinematic tabletop RPG book spread: wide 16:9 landscape composition, dramatic lighting with warm ember-orange highlights against cold ice-blue shadows, rich texture, a clear focal point. No text, no captions, no speech bubbles, no logos, no watermark. This is a still for a cinematic trailer: keep the main subject centred slightly above the middle with a strong silhouette, and keep the lower third darker and uncluttered so a title can sit over it. Scene: an ancient airship, its hull patched and refurbished, races through a storm at night towards a distant town lit by fire on the horizon. In the foreground, on the airship's deck in a small open casket, sits the Nimbus Coronet: a crown carved from Auril's blue-white ice, with a small living flame, one of Agni's avatars, trapped and flickering inside it. Snow and sparks stream past. The crown is the focal point.

references.role: Loose reference for an ancient airship at night; any airship design in this spirit is fine.

request.alt: A crown of blue ice with a trapped flame inside sits in a casket on an airship racing through a storm towards a burning town.
